title: MAPLE: MoE Adaptive Plug-and-play Layer-wise Expert allocation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15299v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparsely-activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers universally fix the same number of routed experts across all layers, a convention that ignores the well-documented heterogeneity in layer-wise redundancy. We demonstrate that this uniformity is systematically suboptimal and propose MAPLE, a plug-and-play framework that reallocates the routed-expert budget heterogeneously across layers of any pretrained MoE LLM, without modifying weights or requiring retraining. Our core contribution is a closed-form sensitivity-guided allocation: we probe each layer's response to variation in expert count, quantify sensitivity using three measures, and derive an analytically optimal budget assignment that directs capacity towards sensitive layers and absorbs reductions in redundant layers. This closed-form solution is further refined by a sensitivity-constrained genetic search that uses layer-wise sensitivity as a prior to guide exploration, yiel

translated_title: MAPLE：一种自适应的即插即用分层专家分配方法
translated_abstract: 稀疏激活的混合专家（MoE）Transformer在所有层中统一固定相同数量的路由专家，这种惯例忽略了对层间冗余性充分记录的异质性。我们证明这种均匀性在系统上是次优的，并提出MAPLE，一个即插即用的框架，可以在任何预训练的MoE大语言模型的各层之间异质性地重新分配路由专家预算，无需修改权重或重新训练。我们的核心贡献是一种基于闭式解的敏感性引导分配：我们探测每一层对专家数量变化的响应，使用三种度量量化敏感性，并推导出一个解析最优的预算分配方案，该方案将容量导向敏感层，并吸收冗余层中的削减。这种闭式解进一步通过敏感性约束的遗传搜索进行优化，该搜索使用层间敏感性作为先验来引导探索，从而产生...
tldr: MAPLE提出一种即插即用的分层专家分配框架，通过闭式敏感性分析和遗传搜索，在无需重新训练的情况下优化预训练MoE模型的专家预算分配，提升性能。
en_tdlr: MAPLE proposes a plug-and-play layer-wise expert allocation framework that optimizes expert budget distribution in pretrained MoE models via closed-form sensitivity analysis and genetic search, improving performance without retraining.
